title: Mara and the Inheritance
author: Lena Whitlock
blurb: Zephyrine Kavanagh, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
